content: {"like":["Non-violent episodes like 'The Incident of the Dust Flower'","Episode starring Wishbone is very good","Episode 'Incident of the Deserter' is very good","Episode 'Incident of the Last Chance' has almost no violence","Realistic black-and-white footage","Good sound","Spooky attempt to differ from typical western","Action fun with Favor, Rowdy, Wishbone, Pete Nolan","Season 2 Volume 2 is a 4-star classic TV experience","Well worth $12 for 16 episodes","Season 3 is next","Western action continues with second tier characters","The show has plenty of good episodes to spare"],"dislike":["Bad moment with Darren Stevens' mom playing a gypsy with fake sun tan and bad wig, trying to cast a spell on the drovers","Problem with drunken Indian allowed to pull out his knife by boss Gil Favor","Ignorance and bigotry in the old west, e.g., Jesus (Heysoos) being accused of being a witch"]}
